name: neon-flow
description: In the neon lit ruins of the city’s network, the corrupted AI known as the System unleashes a digital apocalypse. Rogue data storms the grid, and the rebels’ firewalls, once legendary, are now shattered, their fragments raining down like the bones of a lost revolution. You are the Green Div Savior, a renegade of clean data, fighting to restore order and keep the neon flow alive in a world on the edge.
